sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: BioVision analyses your scan on your iPhone. We do not have accounts, servers that receive your health data, advertising or tracking.

sections.heading: Camera
sections.body: The front camera is used only during a scan. Video frames are analysed in memory to measure your pulse and are never recorded or uploaded. One face photo and two eye photos are taken to analyse skin signs and estimate haemoglobin. They stay in the app's temporary storage and are removed by the system.

sections.heading: Your answers and profile
sections.body: Age, sex, pregnancy, height, weight and your answers are used only to calculate your report. They stay in memory and are cleared when you start a new scan or close the app.

sections.heading: Location
sections.body: If you choose to find nearby healthcare, your location is used on your iPhone to sort the list. It is not stored or sent anywhere.

sections.heading: Stored on your iPhone
sections.body: Only your language choice and that you accepted these terms are saved on your device.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: Your report leaves the app only when you tap Share and choose where to send it. Photos are never included.

sections.heading: Third parties
sections.body: BioVision contains no analytics, advertising or tracking software, and does not sell or share personal data.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: BioVision is designed for adults. Children under 18 should use it with a parent or guardian.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: If this policy changes, the app will ask you to review it again before you continue.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions, use the support link on BioVision's App Store page.

sections.heading: About BioVision
sections.body: BioVision is a health-information prototype. It estimates health indicators from your camera and your answers and suggests which kind of doctor may help.

sections.heading: Not medical advice
sections.body: BioVision is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any disease. Its estimates can be wrong. Always confirm results with a qualified doctor or laboratory test, and never delay or ignore medical advice because of the app.

sections.heading: Emergencies
sections.body: If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, severe bleeding, or thoughts of harming yourself, call 112 or Tele-MANAS 14416 immediately.

sections.heading: Accuracy
sections.body: Lighting, movement, make-up, skin tone and camera quality affect the results. Haemoglobin is an estimate from eyelid colour, not a blood test. Heart-rate readings are not suitable for diagnosing heart conditions.

sections.heading: Doctor directory
sections.body: Doctor and hospital details come from the hospitals' public websites and may change. Confirm timings and availability with the hospital.

sections.heading: Your responsibility
sections.body: Use BioVision only for yourself or with the consent of the person being scanned, and follow the on-screen instructions for eye photos.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: BioVision is provided as is, without warranties. To the extent permitted by law, the makers are not liable for decisions made using the app.
